faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes AMG GT C use?
faqLeft.a: The AMG GT C uses the M178 - a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8. This engine was fitted throughout the car's production run from 2015 to 2023.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes AMG GT C engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £5,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my AMG GT C?
faqLeft.a: The AMG GT C uses the M178 V8. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M178 AMG GT C engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace valve covers, gaskets and coolant components as standard on every M178 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used AMG GT C engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my AMG GT C if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AMG GT C engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most AMG GT C owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
